content_units: Best Fit for Spreadsheet Automation Upskilling

For your background and goal,   Course X is the better fit  . It matches your current skill level, stays within your time limit comfortably, and is more likely to produce   job-visible wins within 6 months  .
Course-by-Course Comparison
Course   Duration   Weekly Time   Cost   Core Topics   Coding Required   Fit for Your Goal
Course X   6 weeks   4 hrs/week   USD 240   Excel formulas; Power Query; dashboards   No     Strong fit
Course Y   8 weeks   5 hrs/week   USD 380   Python pandas; data cleaning; automation scripts   Basic programming assumed   Moderate fit
Why Course X fits better
-   Fast payoff:   Excel formulas, Power Query, and dashboards are directly usable in operations roles.
-   Low ramp-up risk:   You already use spreadsheets and have almost no coding background.
-   Promotion-friendly output:   Dashboards, cleaner reporting, and faster recurring tasks are easy to show to managers.
-   Better time cushion:   4 hours/week leaves room to practice on real work files without exceeding your 5-hour cap.
-   Lower cost:   It is cheaper and likely gives a faster return for your near-term goal.
Where Course Y is stronger
- Builds a more scalable automation foundation.
- Python/pandas can become more powerful than spreadsheet-only tools over time.
- Better if you want to move toward analytics, data ops, or technical automation later.
Main trade-off
Course Y is   not a bad course  ; it is just a weaker match for your stated priorities:
- You have   almost no coding
- You want impact within   6 months
- You can spend   at most 5 hours/week
Because Course Y already assumes programming basics, much of your effort may go into   learning coding first  , not producing visible work improvements quickly.
Recommendation for Your Promotion Timeline
Choose Course X now.
It gives you the highest chance of delivering practical improvements such as:
- automated cleanup of recurring spreadsheets
- better monthly/weekly reporting
- dashboard creation for KPI tracking
- reduced manual copy-paste work using Power Query
Those outcomes are easier to apply immediately in operations and easier to present as evidence of increased responsibility.
Best-Option Cards
Option 1:   Course X     Best near-term choice for operations-focused promotion impact   Lower risk, faster application, lower cost
Pick Course X
Option 2:   Course Y     Better long-term if you want technical automation beyond spreadsheets   Higher learning curve, stronger future scalability
Explore pandas
Quick Actions
Build Excel Plan
Learn Power Query
Decision Context

Based on your profile: 2 years in operations, strong spreadsheet comfort, minimal coding exposure, max 5 hours/week, and a goal of promotion-relevant skills in 6 months. If you finish Course X and want a next step, Python can be your phase 2 after you have already created visible wins.
